text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Turner Construction Company is renovating a 13-storey affordable housing building owned by the Toronto Community Housing Corporation at 389 Church Street. The site is located in the north-east corner of Church Street and Granby Street. The renovation is currently in progress, operating under a monthly Street Occupation Permit. Transportation Services is requesting approval to close the sidewalk and a portion of the westbound lane on the north side of Granby Street abutting the site to facilitate the redevelopment. The proposed construction staging area is being requested for a period of 15 months.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the closure of the sidewalk and 2.1 metre wide portion of the westbound lane on the north side of Granby Street, between a point 38 metres east of Elizabeth Street and point 32 metres further east, from February 21, 2019 to May 31, 2020. 2. Rescinded the existing parking machine regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday, and from 1:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m., Sunday, on the south side of Granby Street, between Church Street and a point 37 metres east. 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on the south side of Granby Street, between Church Street and a point 37 metres east. 4. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Granby Street, between Church Street and a point 36.6 metres east. 5.
